features: means of disjoint 20-change blocks, last 5 mean, last 5 absolute mean, last 5 squared mean
split_rule: chronological independent episodes; no overlapping windows; train-only standardization; validation retained but not used for selection
optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B analytic gradients maxiter=160 ftol=1e-10
positive_gate: both seeds candidate test MSE < 0.8 * zero forecast on BOTH positive processes; objective decrease >1%; finite predictions and gradient checks pass
null_gate: both seeds candidate test MSE <= 1.10 * zero forecast
market_permission: only if all gates pass; then separately verify market 950/451 origin-target identity and historical MLE/linear reuse. No 2022. No market accessed in this pilot.
novelty: Damped/exponential response dictionaries are established, not an innovation claim. Learned bounded rates plus low-capacity nonlinear coefficient map is one candidate parameterization only.
linear_equivalence: For fixed D, X W D equals an ordinary linear horizon output X B with B=W D. Linear dictionary is a rank/subspace restriction, not a new predictor class. Nonlinear fixed dictionary similarly is an MLP output constrained to span(D).
generator_interface: generator outputs only observed 60 changes and future cumulative changes; no true parameter, latent state, or generating coefficient is passed to training
retention: all 60 fits, predictions, targets, optimizer receipts, parameters, gradient checks and runtime retained; no seed selection
